## Checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the linked issue; no unrelated refactors or formatting-only changes
- [ ] Tests added/updated; bug fixes include a regression test named after the issue
- [ ] Docs / ADR updated when behaviour, API, schema, or architecture changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data in the diff or logs
- [ ] Protected paths untouched (lockfiles via package manager only; no `.env`, CODEOWNERS, rulesets, `.claude/settings.json` changes without a human owner)
